headline: Asian stocks soared on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, but bitcoin did not follow, with traders waiting for Wednesday's US inflation data and a likely December Fed rate hike.

stories.title: Asia piles into the Nvidia rally, but bitcoin sits it out
stories.summary: Asian stock markets jumped on Tuesday after Nvidia's board brought back Jensen Huang as CEO and Wall Street had one of its best days in years. Bitcoin did not join in: it faded from Monday's high back toward $61,000. Monday's jump was mostly traders who had bet on a fall being forced to close out, not new buyers.
points: Taiwan's Taiex rose more than 9%, South Korea's Kospi 6.5% to 5,014.41 and Japan's Nikkei 3.9% to 58,654.40 on Tuesday, per the Associated Press.
On Monday the S&P 500 had its best day since April 2025, per the Associated Press; it rose 4.7% to 7,237.17 and the Nasdaq 6.51%, per The Motley Fool.
Bitcoin reached $64,603 on Monday before fading back toward $61,000, per crypto.news and Bitcoin Magazine.
About $321 million of bitcoin bets were wiped out on Monday, $224 million of them bets on a fall, per Bitcoin Magazine.

stories.title: Fed's Williams won't rule out back-to-back hikes as money keeps leaving bitcoin funds
stories.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said on Monday he is not ruling out raising rates at two meetings in a row to fight inflation. Traders see a December hike as very likely. US spot bitcoin funds have lost money for four weeks running, and October inflation data lands on Wednesday.
points: Williams said he expects inflation of about 3.5% at the end of 2026 and a return to 2% only by 2028, per KuCoin.
CME FedWatch put the chance of a quarter-point hike in December at 93.2% on 23 Nov, down from as high as 99% earlier, per KuCoin.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $1.79 billion last week, their fourth weekly outflow in a row; BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $1.37 billion, per The Block (23 Nov).
Ether funds lost $314 million over the same week, their eighth negative week in a row, per The Block.
October PCE inflation and the second estimate of Q3 GDP are out Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok); see the calendar below.

stories.title: US moves to seize $1.17 billion in USDC from the Binance hack
stories.summary: The Justice Department asked a court to hand over USDC stablecoins traced to last month's Binance hack. Circle has frozen the coins and says it will issue fresh USDC of the same amount once a court orders the forfeiture. A court has not ruled yet.
points: The civil forfeiture complaint covers about $1.17 billion in USDC across 36 addresses on 18 blockchains, per The Block.
US officials attribute the 29 Oct hack to North Korea's Lazarus Group, per The Block.
Binance put its losses at about $6.34 billion; US authorities have helped freeze, seize or return more than $2.9 billion since the hack, per The Block.
Circle cannot move the frozen tokens, so it agreed to issue new USDC equal to the seized amount after a court order, per The Block.

briefs.title: Monad's large MON unlock is today
briefs.summary: About 16.61 billion MON, worth roughly $217 million, unlock on 24 Nov, one year after launch, per CoinOtag. Trackers disagree on the size; see the unlock table on this page for this desk's figure and confidence.

briefs.title: South Korea's crypto law draft is expected this week
briefs.summary: The Financial Services Commission will release a draft Digital Asset Basic Act later this week, expected to cover exchange licensing and require banks to hold more than 50% of any consortium issuing won stablecoins, per The Block.

briefs.title: White House reviews the CFTC's prediction-market rule
briefs.summary: The CFTC's final rule on prediction markets reached the White House budget office for review on 20 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Kalshi keeps operating in New York for now
briefs.summary: A New York judge denied the state's request for a temporary restraining order against Kalshi without ruling on the merits; a fuller hearing is set for 7 or 8 Jan, per Front Office Sports.

briefs.title: iPhone hacking kits target crypto wallets
briefs.summary: A malicious-ads operation researchers call MoldyRoost uses nearly 500 ad domains to plant kits that steal wallet recovery phrases; Forbes advises keeping iOS updated.

briefs.title: Strategy and Metaplanet leave MSCI indexes on 30 Nov
briefs.summary: MSCI removes both bitcoin-holding companies from its indexes at the close on 30 Nov; JPMorgan estimates about $2.8 billion of forced selling by index funds, per Altcoin Buzz.
